pages.title: Wardens of the groves
text: Not every March tree stands still. In each land where a [March tree](march_trees) grows, a few of its kind have stood up and walk, wearing the same wood and leaf as the tree they came from.

They are gentle. Brush one for its reagent once a minute, and tempt and breed it with that same reagent. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though it has no gift of its own.

pages.title: Seven wardens
text: - **Hearth Warden**: the Hearthoak of the Steppe, broad and heavy on stubby roots. Drops **Hearth Bark**.
- **Grove Elder**: the March tree of the Highlands groves, tall and bent over a staff, bearded in moss. Drops **Elder Bark**.
- **Frostpine Sentinel**: the Frostpine of the Snow Fields, a tall trunk under a cone of snowy needles, its branch arms reaching out from under the lowest boughs. Drops **Frostpine Bark**.
- **Snagwalker**: the Cinderwood snag of the Ember Wastes, a burnt deadwood trunk snapped off at the top, still smouldering. Drops **Cinder Bark** (yellow dye).
- **Weeping Warden**: the willow of the Reed Fen, hunched under a curtain of strands. Drops **Weeping Knots**.
- **Bellcap Elder**: the Bellcap of the Crystal Fields, a squat stem under one huge cap. Drops **Bellcap Spores** (magenta dye).
- **Stiltwood**: the Strider of the Shallows, carried high on arching prop roots. Drops **Stilt Roots**.

pages.title: What they are like
text: Every walking tree has **48 health** and **8 armour**. They are slow, keep away from monsters, and walk in groups of two to four. Each drops **1 to 3** of its reagent, more with Looting.
The Glimmer Ridge grows no tree, so it has no warden. The one tree that walks and is not gentle is the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden).
